WHAT WAS ASKED — ROLE-SPECIFIC ACCOUNTS
A Summer Intern 2027 candidate reports shortlisting via Big Code, a short recruiter screen, and two 45-minute technical interviews. The account emphasizes explaining DSA solutions while coding in a shared document and discussing practical AI use. Its opinion that DP was not emphasized is not a company-wide exclusion of DP.
Source: https://www.oahelper.in/interview-experience/Mjg1OA

An intern account names arrays and priority queues in the first interview, followed by further easy-to-medium DSA, a project explanation and discussion of the candidate's technology choices.
Source: https://www.oahelper.in/interview-experience/MjcwNg

An SWE-intern report describes an unproctored, two-question OA and problems involving tree/XOR operations and range-update or arithmetic-progression reasoning. Interview examples include graph reachability and finding when timestamped friendships connect everyone. The writer's complexity claims are not independently validated here.
Source: https://www.oahelper.in/interview-experience/MjQ2MQ

A separate off-campus intern report describes an OA with 15 MCQs and three coding tasks, then multiple DSA rounds involving strings and binary trees and a culture-fit discussion. The format differs from other records; verify the current invitation.
Source: https://www.oahelper.in/interview-experience/MjQ4NQ

QUESTION PATTERNS IN OAHELPER
78 published non-mock question records. Types: CODING: 77, MCQ: 1.
Difficulty labels: Medium: 62, Hard: 10, Easy: 6.
72/78 records have usable topic labels.
Most frequent stored topics: Array (43), Greedy (27), String (18), Math (18), Binary Search (14), Sorting (13), Prefix Sum (13), Dynamic Programming (11).
A question can have several tags. These frequencies describe the uploaded corpus; they do not predict the next OA. Mock and duplicate-marked questions are excluded.

SOURCE NOTES

Campus labels in calendar reports can include off-campus applications; an interview author’s college is not necessarily the interview venue. Different roles, seniority levels and dates can have different processes.
